section.content: The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery core, which comprises an air bag. The air bag has an inner chamber and at least one banding, and the banding is equipped with fluid infusion space and cutting area, and fluid infusion space and cutting area arrange in proper order along the width direction of banding, and fluid infusion space and inner chamber intercommunication, and the cutting area is used for sealing the one end that the inner chamber was kept away from in the fluid infusion space, and the fluid infusion space is constructed as the operable closed inner chamber. The position accessible cutting area that the banding was equipped with fluid infusion space and cutting area realizes sealedly, and when needs carried out the change of electrolyte, will cut off the cutting area, and the one end that the inner chamber was kept away from in the fluid infusion space does not have the sealing in cutting area, and the fluid infusion space is exposed, and the inner chamber is followed through the fluid infusion space and is replenished electrolyte this moment, closes the inner chamber through the fluid infusion space after the replenishment is accomplished for this lithium ion battery core continues to use. Therefore, the problem that the lithium ion battery is in capacity jumping and failure due to insufficient electrolyte after long-time use is solved, and the service life of the lithium ion battery is prolonged.

本实用新型涉及一种锂离子电池芯，包括气袋。气袋具有内腔以及至少一条封边，封边设有补液空间及裁切区，补液空间和裁切区沿封边的宽度方向依次排布，且补液空间与内腔连通，裁切区用于封闭补液空间远离内腔的一端，补液空间被构造为可操作地封闭内腔。封边设有补液空间和裁切区的位置可通过裁切区实现密封，而在需要进行电解液的更换时，将裁切区切掉，补液空间远离内腔的一端没有裁切区的密封，补液空间被暴露，此时通过补液空间往内腔补充电解液，补充完成后通过补液空间封闭内腔，使得该锂离子电池芯继续使用。如此，解决了锂离子电池长时间使用后因电解液不足导致容量跳水并失效的问题，延长了锂离子电池的使用寿命。

Lithium ion battery coreTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of battery structures, in particular to a lithium ion battery core.

Background

After the lithium ion battery is used for a long time, a part of electrolyte can be absorbed due to the expansion of the positive electrode and the negative electrode, so that the electrolyte circulating between the two electrodes is insufficient, the positive electrode and the negative electrode are locally exhausted, and lithium ions are separated out to reduce the capacity of the battery. Once the positive electrode is exhausted to a certain extent, the lithium ion battery has capacity jump, and thus the lithium ion battery is out of service.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

In view of the above, it is necessary to provide a lithium ion battery cell capable of replenishing an electrolyte solution in order to solve the problem of insufficient electrolyte solution after long-term use of the lithium ion battery.

A lithium ion battery cell, comprising:

the sealing edge is provided with a liquid supplementing space and a cutting area, the liquid supplementing space and the cutting area are sequentially arranged along the width direction of the sealing edge, the liquid supplementing space is communicated with the inner cavity, and the cutting area is used for sealing one end, far away from the inner cavity, of the liquid supplementing space so as to prevent electrolyte from flowing out of the air bag from the liquid supplementing space;

wherein the fluid replacement space is configured to operatively enclose the lumen.

Through setting up foretell lithium ion battery core, in the use, the banding is equipped with the position accessible cutting area of fluid infusion space and cutting area and realizes sealedly, prevent that electrolyte from flowing out the air pocket from the fluid infusion space, and when the change of electrolyte needs to be carried out, cut off the cutting area, the inner chamber was kept away from in the fluid infusion space one end does not have the sealing in cutting area, the fluid infusion space is exposed, this moment, toward inner chamber supplementary electrolyte through the fluid infusion space, seal the inner chamber through the fluid infusion space after the replenishment is accomplished, make this lithium ion battery core continue to use. Therefore, the problem that the lithium ion battery has capacity jumping and is invalid due to insufficient electrolyte after a long time is solved, and the service life of the lithium ion battery is prolonged.

In one embodiment, the fluid infusion space has a first end and a second end opposite to each other in the width direction of the seal, the first end is connected to the cutting area, and the dimension of the first end in the length direction of the seal is smaller than the dimension of the second end in the length direction of the seal.

In one embodiment, the size of the fluid infusion space along the length direction of the sealing edge is gradually increased from the first end to the second end.

In one embodiment, an orthographic projection of the liquid supplementing space on a plane parallel to the width direction and the length direction of the sealing edge is an isosceles trapezoid.

In one of them embodiment, the fluid infusion space still includes connect in first end with first side and the second side between the second end, first side with the second side is located the fluid infusion space is along the length direction's of banding opposite sides, first side with the second side is the arc limit.

In one embodiment, an orthographic projection of the cutting area on a plane parallel to the width direction and the length direction of the seal edge is a rectangle, and a dimension of the cutting area along the length direction of the seal edge is smaller than or equal to a dimension of the first end along the length direction of the seal edge.

In one embodiment, the fluid infusion space has a first end and a second end opposite to each other in the width direction of the seal edge, the first end is connected to the cut area, the first end and the second end have the same size in the length direction of the seal edge, and the size of the first end in the length direction of the seal edge is larger than the size of the cut area in the length direction of the seal edge.

In one embodiment, the edge sealing is provided with at least two fluid infusion spaces and at least two cutting areas, the at least two fluid infusion spaces are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the edge sealing, and each fluid infusion space and the corresponding cutting area are sequentially arranged along the width direction of the edge sealing.

In one embodiment, the air bag comprises two sealing edges, the two sealing edges are positioned at two opposite sides of the air bag, and at least one sealing edge is provided with the liquid supplementing space and the cutting area.

In one embodiment, the lithium ion battery cell further comprises two tabs, and the two tabs are connected to two opposite ends of the air bag along the length direction of the sealed edge.

Detailed Description

In order to make the aforementioned objects, features and advantages of the present invention comprehensible, embodiments accompanied with figures are described in detail below. In the following description, numerous specific details are set forth in order to provide a thorough understanding of the present invention. This invention may, however, be embodied in many different forms and should not be construed as limited to the embodiments set forth herein.

As shown in fig. 1, a lithium ion battery cell provided in an embodiment of the present invention includes an air bag 10, the air bag 10 has an inner cavity 11 and at least one sealing edge 12, the sealing edge 12 is provided with a fluid infusion space 13 and a cutting area 14, the fluid infusion space 13 and the cutting area 14 are sequentially arranged along a width direction of the sealing edge 12, the fluid infusion space 13 is communicated with the inner cavity 11, and the cutting area 14 is configured to seal one end of the fluid infusion space 13 away from the inner cavity 11, so as to prevent an electrolyte from flowing out of the air bag 10 from the fluid infusion space 13.

Wherein the fluid replacement space 13 is configured to operatively enclose the inner cavity 11.

Through setting up foretell lithium ion battery core, in the use, banding 12 is equipped with the position accessible cutting area 14 of fluid infusion space 13 and cutting area 14 and realizes sealedly, prevent that electrolyte from flowing out air pocket 10 from fluid infusion space 13, and when needing to carry out the change of electrolyte, cut off cutting area 14, the one end that inner chamber 11 was kept away from to fluid infusion space 13 does not have the sealing of cutting area 14, fluid infusion space 13 is exposed, supplement electrolyte toward inner chamber 11 through fluid infusion space 13 this moment, through fluid infusion space 13 closed inner chamber 11 after the completion of replenishment, make this lithium ion battery core continue to use. Therefore, the problem that the lithium ion battery is in failure due to the fact that the electrolyte is insufficient after the lithium ion battery is used for a long time is solved, and the service life of the lithium ion battery is prolonged.

It should be noted that the battery cell 30 and the electrolyte are stored in the inner cavity 11, the sealing edge 12 in the above embodiment is formed when the sealing head is used to heat seal the airbag 10, and the fluid infusion space 13 is formed by using a special sealing head and not performing heat sealing on a reserved portion during heat sealing by using the sealing edge 12.

It will also be appreciated that the fluid infusion space 13 may also be heat sealed to close the cavity 11.

It should be further noted that, when the electrolyte is replenished, as shown in fig. 2, the cutting area 14 is cut away to form a communication port 15, one end of the fluid replenishing space 13 away from the inner cavity 11 is exposed through the communication port 15, since a part of the fluid replenishing space 13 is reserved during the heat sealing process of the edge sealing 12 without heat sealing, the fluid replenishing space 13 can be communicated with the outside through the communication port 15, and then as shown in fig. 3, a fluid replenishing device, such as a fluid replenishing pipe 200 in fig. 3, is inserted along the communication port 15 to replenish the inner cavity 11 with the electrolyte, and after the replenishment of the electrolyte is completed, as shown in fig. 4, the fluid replenishing space 13 is heat sealed to form the sealing strip 16, and the sealing strip 16 can close the inner cavity 11.

In addition, it should be explained that the length of the liquid supplementing space 13 after heat sealing along the width direction of the sealing edge 12 is enough to seal the inner cavity 11, so as to avoid the leakage of the electrolyte and ensure the reliability of the lithium ion battery cell.

In some embodiments, the lithium ion battery further includes two tabs 20, and the two tabs 20 are connected to opposite ends of the air bag 10 along the length direction of the sealing edge 12.

In practice, as shown in fig. 1, the airbag 10 has a rectangular shape, the sealing edge 12 is located at one side of the airbag 10 and extends along the length direction of the airbag 10, and two tabs 20 are connected to two ends of the airbag 10.

In some embodiments, the bag 10 includes two sealed edges 12, the sealed edges 12 are located on two opposite sides of the bag 10, and at least one sealed edge 12 is provided with the fluid infusion space 13 and the cut-out area 14 in the above embodiments.

In some embodiments, each edge sealing 12 is provided with the liquid supplementing space 13 and the cutting area 14 in the above embodiments, and each edge sealing 12 can supplement electrolyte once, so that the lithium ion battery cell can supplement electrolyte twice, and the service life of the lithium ion battery cell is further prolonged.

In some embodiments, the sealing edge 12 is provided with at least two fluid infusion spaces 13 and at least two cutting areas 14, the at least two fluid infusion spaces 13 are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the sealing edge 12, and each fluid infusion space 13 and a corresponding cutting area 14 are arranged in sequence along the width direction of the sealing edge 12.

It is understood that each fluid infusion space 13 and the corresponding one of the cutting areas 14 can be replenished with electrolyte once, while at least two fluid infusion spaces 13 and at least two cutting areas 14 can be replenished with electrolyte at least twice. Therefore, the service life of the lithium ion battery cell can be further prolonged.

Further, each sealing edge 12 is provided with at least two fluid infusion spaces 13 and at least two cutting areas 14.

In some embodiments, the fluid infusion space 13 has a first end 131 and a second end opposite to each other in the width direction of the seal 12, and the first end 131 is connected to the cutting area 14, and the dimension of the first end 131 in the length direction of the seal 12 is smaller than the dimension of the second end in the length direction of the seal 12.

It should be noted that before the cutting area 14 is cut, the first end 131 of the fluid infusion space 13 is closed, while the second end of the fluid infusion space 13 is open, and after the cutting area 14 is cut, the first end 131 of the fluid infusion space 13 becomes open. The dimension of the first end 131 along the length direction of the sealing edge 12 is smaller than that of the second end, that is, the opening of the first section 131 is smaller than that of the second end, so that the electrolyte can be prevented from being splashed out of the opening of the first end 131 in the process of liquid supplement.

In embodiment 1, the size of the fluid infusion space 13 along the length direction of the sealing edge 12 gradually increases from the first end 131 to the second end, so that the electrolyte can flow down along the sidewall of the fluid infusion space 13 after splashing into the fluid infusion space 13, and the electrolyte is prevented from accumulating in the fluid infusion space 13 to affect the heat sealing of the fluid infusion space 13.

In practical application, the orthographic projection of the fluid infusion space 13 on a plane parallel to the width direction and the length direction of the seal edge 12 is an isosceles trapezoid.

It should be explained with reference to fig. 1 that the fluid infusion space 13 in fig. 1 is in the shape of an isosceles trapezoid, the width direction of the seal 12 is the up-down direction in fig. 1, and the length direction of the seal 12 is the left-right direction in fig. 1, so that the plane parallel to the width direction and the length direction of the seal 12 is the front plane in fig. 1.

In embodiment 2, the fluid infusion space 13 has a size gradually increasing from the first end 131 to the second end along the length of the sealing edge 12.

Referring to fig. 5, in practical applications, the fluid infusion space 13 further includes a first side 132 and a second side 133 connected between the first end 131 and the second end, the first side 132 and the second side 133 are located at two opposite sides of the fluid infusion space 13 along the length direction of the sealing edge 12, and both the first side 132 and the second side 133 are arc-shaped sides.

In embodiment 3, referring to fig. 6, the fluid infusion space 13 has a first end 131 and a second end opposite to each other along the width direction of the seal 12, the first end 131 is connected to the cutting area 14, the first end 131 and the second end have the same size along the length direction of the seal 12, and the size of the first end 131 along the length direction of the seal 12 is larger than the size of the cutting area 14 along the length direction of the seal 12.

In embodiment 3, the dimension of the trimmed area 14 in the longitudinal direction of the seal edge 12 is smaller than the first end 131, and the electrolyte can be prevented from splashing out of the communication port 15 after the trimmed area 14 is trimmed to form the communication port 15.

In some embodiments, an orthographic projection of the cropped area 14 on a plane parallel to the width and length directions of the hem seal 12 is rectangular, and the dimension of the cropped area 14 along the length direction of the hem seal 12 is less than or equal to the dimension of the first end 131 along the length direction of the hem seal 12 to reduce cropping and ensure the sealing strength of the hem seal 12.

It will be appreciated that when the fluid infusion space 13 of embodiment 3 is used, the dimension of the cut out region 14 along the length of the hem seal 12 is less than the dimension of the first end 131 along the length of the hem seal 12.

In the embodiment shown in fig. 1, the seal head for heat-sealing the sealing edge 12 is provided with a notch with a trapezoidal cross section, so that after the sealing edge 12 is heat-sealed, the fluid infusion space 13 with the shape shown in fig. 1 is formed. Similarly, in the embodiments shown in fig. 5 and 6, the seal heads for heat sealing the seal edge 12 are notched in corresponding shapes to form the fluid infusion spaces 13 in corresponding shapes, respectively.

In addition, when the fluid infusion space 13 is heat-sealed after the completion of fluid infusion, a conventional cap may be used without limitation.

The technical features of the embodiments described above may be arbitrarily combined, and for the sake of brevity, all possible combinations of the technical features in the embodiments described above are not described, but should be considered as being within the scope of the present specification as long as there is no contradiction between the combinations of the technical features.

The above-mentioned embodiments only express several embodiments of the present invention, and the description thereof is more specific and detailed, but not construed as limiting the scope of the utility model. It should be noted that various changes and modifications can be made by those skilled in the art without departing from the spirit of the utility model, and these changes and modifications are all within the scope of the utility model.
